title.en: Chapter 14 — The King and the Saddle

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: I fled alone and walked seven days.
I reached a city with sane people.

sentences.ar: لاحظت إنهم بيركبوا الخيل بلا سرج.
sentences.en: I noticed they rode horses with no saddle.
I made a saddle with my hands and gave it to the king.
The king rode on it and was very pleased.

sentences.ar: صرت أعمل سروج وصرت غني وقريب منه.
sentences.en: I began making saddles and became rich and close to him.
He married me to a woman from a great family.
